summary: Frontend-only retest of the updated GallerySection on https://auto-repair-stage.preview.emergentagent.com/#gallery. Verified exactly 9 images render, all 9 asset URLs return HTTP 200 (curl) and load in-browser (naturalWidth > 0, no broken images, no failed network requests), heading 'Einblick in unsere Werkstatt' present, masonry layout resolves to 3 columns on desktop (1920px) with images in 3 distinct x-offsets, 2 columns on tablet (768px), 1 column on mobile (390px) with no horizontal overflow, and hover changes border to rgb(249,115,22) (#F97316). No console errors. Old 5-image set fully replaced.

issues: Performance: 9 uncompressed originals (~200-490KB each, up to 2000x1500px) are loaded with no loading="lazy" / width-height attributes; adds ~3MB to the page and can cause layout shift. Recommend loading="lazy" + decoding="async" on images 4-9.

Minor: CSS multi-column fill means the visual order differs from the DOM order (Porsche appears first top-left); acceptable for a masonry gallery but worth noting if a specific image order is desired.
Minor: no lightbox/zoom on click - images are non-interactive apart from the border hover.

action_items: Optional: add loading="lazy" and explicit dimensions to gallery images to cut ~3MB initial payload and prevent CLS.
critical_code_review_comments: GallerySection.jsx repeats the same markup 9 times (DRY violation) - move the 9 src/alt pairs into an array and map over them; this also makes future image swaps a one-line change.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/components/GallerySection.jsx (added data-testid="gallery-image-1..9" to the 9 elements for testability; no functional change)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Gallery images now have data-testid gallery-image-1..9 plus data-testid="gallery-section" on the section. All 5 requested checks pass. Only remaining suggestions are perf (lazy loading) and a DRY refactor of GallerySection.jsx.
